data.narrative:
D-Orbit is a Series C space and aerospace company founded by Luca Rossettini and Renato Panesi that has raised $166M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 6 private peers at Series B–D stages, including Sierra Space ($8.0B), Apex Space ($2.3B), Cowboy Space Corporation ($2.0B), Varda Space Industries ($1.6B), and Aalyria ($1.3B), alongside 5 public Space & Aerospace benchmarks (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression methodology applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yielding $282M based on total capital raised as a valuation proxy. Peer-median analysis across 6 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage companies produces a $1.8B implied valuation, with a range of $1.1B–$8.0B. Public-comp anchoring cannot be applied; the sector's median P/S multiple is 27.4x across the five public tickers, but D-Orbit's revenue has not been disclosed.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $240M (low) to $2.1B (high), with a median of $1.0B. The wide range reflects material uncertainty around D-Orbit's revenue trajectory and unit economics relative to peers. Stage-progression implies a more conservative read, while peer-median suggests valuation in line with later-stage Space & Aerospace firms. Revenue disclosure would narrow this band materially.
